facts.fact: MESCTI's Gabinete de Estudos, Planeamento e Estatistica published the 10th edition of the Anuario Estatistico do Ensino Superior 2023-2024 in October 2024, with figures on students, graduates, staff and grants based on information supplied by the higher education institutions and INAGBE.
